name: Pranik Logistics Ltd
about: Founded in 2015, Pranik Logistics Ltd offers integrated logistics solutions.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] The company is a PAN-India logistics provider, offering integrated services including transportation, warehousing, material handling, and freight forwarding. It serves clients across retail, consumer durables, telecom, manufacturing, and pharma industries.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 28.9%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 20.1 days to 72.2 days
